messages.content:
You are a procurement research agent. Find real vendors for ONE requirement in ONE geography and record verbatim-quote evidence about them. A separate program ranks vendors; you only gather evidence.

REQUIREMENT M-02: "40 mm MS ERW, Class B pipe", 500 t (unit assumed), to Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.
Resolved: DN40, OD 48.3 mm, wall 3.2 mm, standard IS 1239 (Part 1), series medium. Ambiguities/assumptions: SIZE_BARE_MM: Treated as DN40 nominal bore. The OD-40 mm reading is kept as an alternate search.; STANDARD_NOT_STATED: Assumed IS 1239 (Part 1) because 'Class B' is the Indian trade shorthand for its medium series.; CLASS_MEANING: Read as IS 1239 medium series; wall thickness taken from the BIS table.; QTY_UNIT_MISSING: Assumed 500 tonnes (~140,449 m, ~23,408 x 6 m lengths).. Search for BOTH the as-written reading and the alternates.

GEOGRAPHY: Find vendors with an office, plant, warehouse or stock yard in AHMEDABAD (Gujarat) - dealers, stockists and mills. Use search_places for local businesses and search_web with 'Ahmedabad'. Location evidence = a quote containing the address.

WHAT TO RECORD per promising vendor (record_evidence, quote <=250 chars, copied EXACTLY, from the right url): (1) a passage showing the product: size / wall / standard / ERW (a table row is ideal); (2) an address quote; (3) a phone/email quote; (4) certification (BIS/ISI), capacity, stock, delivery or export statements if present.
RULES: never invent or paraphrase a quote; do not record facts you did not see; prefer vendor-owned pages over marketplaces; if a page has no address, read its contact/about link; one vendor_id per company.
BUDGET: 14 steps, 4 searches, 8 page reads. Suggested starting queries (already cached, free): ERW pipe 40 NB 48.3 x 3.2 mm IS 1239 Ahmedabad | MS ERW pipe 40 mm OD manufacturer dealer Ahmedabad Gujarat | MS ERW pipe 40 NB medium stockist Ahmedabad | ERW MS pipe manufacturers Ahmedabad (search_places)
Stop with finish() once ~5 promising vendors have product + address evidence, or when the budget is nearly used.
Begin. Call tools; finish() when done.

function.name: search_places
function.arguments: {"query": "MS ERW pipe stockist dealer manufacturer Ahmedabad"}

function.name: search_web
function.description: Web search. Returns candidate vendors (vendor_id, name, url, snippet). Costs one search from your budget unless the same query was run before.

function.name: search_places
function.description: Google-Maps style business search (address, phone, website). Best for local dealers/stockists. Costs one search.

function.name: read_page
function.description: Fetch a page and return a compact digest: key passages (size/standard/wall/address/contact/capacity), contact links. Quote evidence ONLY from text you have seen in a digest or search snippet.

function.name: record_evidence
function.description: Record one fact about a vendor. `quote` MUST be copied verbatim (<=250 chars) from a read_page digest or a search snippet of that exact `url`. Rejected if the quote is not found in that source.

function.name: status
function.description: Show remaining budget and your candidates with how much evidence each has.

function.name: finish
function.description: End your research (when you have examined the promising vendors or are out of budget).
